findings.en_sentence: At least a dozen Velociraptor skeletons have been unearthed, which is the largest number discovered for any dromaeosaurid.
findings.es_sentence: Se han excavado al menos una docena de esqueletos de Velociraptor, que es el mayor número descubierto para cualquier dromaeosáurido.
findings.problem: Not true: Microraptor is known from hundreds of specimens, so Velociraptor does not have the largest number of skeletons of any dromaeosaurid. The claim comes from eswiki only.
findings.correct: At least a dozen Velociraptor skeletons have been found, making it one of the best-represented dromaeosaurids.
findings.checked_in: F077 (eswiki intro); knowledge (Microraptor has hundreds of specimens)

findings.en_sentence: It possessed a large hand with three long fingers ending in curved claws that were structurally similar to modern bird wing bones.
findings.es_sentence: Poseía una mano grande con tres dedos largos que finalizaban en garras curvas, estructuralmente parecidas a los huesos de las alas de las aves actuales.
findings.problem: Says the claws resembled bird wing bones; the comparison is between the hand bones (digits and unguals as a whole) and the wing skeleton of modern birds, not the claws alone. The ES version ties it to the claws even more firmly.
findings.correct: Its large hand had three long fingers ending in strongly curved claws; the hand bones were similar in construction and flexibility to the wing bones of modern birds.

findings.en_sentence: Velociraptor was warm-blooded to some degree due to the high energy requirements of hunting.
findings.es_sentence: Velociraptor era de sangre caliente en algún grado debido a los altos requerimientos energéticos de la caza.
findings.problem: States warm-bloodedness as fact and makes hunting its cause. The source only infers some endothermy from the energy needed to hunt, and the same section (F055, F056) says bone growth and nasal cavities point to a more moderate metabolism than modern endotherms.
findings.correct: Velociraptor was probably warm-blooded to some degree, since hunting required a lot of energy, though its bone growth suggests a more moderate metabolism than modern mammals and birds.

findings.en_sentence: While it was once believed that Velociraptor's tail was stiff and rod-like, fossil evidence of an S-shaped tail suggests it had significant horizontal flexibility.
findings.es_sentence: Aunque una vez se creía que la cola de Velociraptor era rígida y en forma de varilla, las pruebas fósiles de una cola en forma de S sugieren que tenía una flexibilidad horizontal significativa.
findings.problem: Suggests the old idea of a stiff tail was wrong. The tail was still stiffened vertically by zygapophyses and ossified tendons; the S-shaped specimen shows only more side-to-side flexibility than once thought.
findings.correct: The tail was stiffened by long bony rods, but at least one specimen with vertebrae curved sideways into an S shows it was more flexible horizontally than once thought.

findings.en_sentence: It is classified as a genus of small dromaeosaurid dinosaurs belonging to the group Eudromaeosauria, which is a subgroup of the family Dromaeosauridae.
findings.es_sentence: Se clasifica como un género de pequeños dinosaurios dromaeosáuridos pertenecientes al grupo Eudromaeosauria, que es un subgrupo de la familia Dromaeosauridae.
findings.problem: Repeats the previous sentence ('genus of dromaeosaurid dinosaurs'); the only new information is Eudromaeosauria.
findings.correct: Within Dromaeosauridae, it belongs to the subgroup Eudromaeosauria.

findings.es_sentence: Se clasifica como un género de pequeños dinosaurios dromaeosáuridos pertenecientes al grupo Eudromaeosauria, que es un subgrupo de la familia Dromaeosauridae.
findings.problem: 'dromaeosáuridos' is a hybrid spelling and differs from 'dromeosáuridos' in the first sentence.

findings.es_sentence: Se han excavado al menos una docena de esqueletos de Velociraptor, que es el mayor número descubierto para cualquier dromaeosáurido.
La garra de hoz agrandada del segundo dedo podía crecer hasta más de 6,5 centímetros de longitud y probablemente se utilizaba para inmovilizar a la presa.
findings.problem: 'segundo dedo' is ambiguous because the previous sentence is about the hand; the English says toe. 'hasta más de' is also awkward.
findings.correct: La garra en forma de hoz del segundo dedo del pie podía superar los 6,5 centímetros de longitud…

findings.en_sentence: Fossil evidence shows that a bite wound on a Velociraptor skull did not heal, suggesting the injury likely caused the animal's death.
findings.es_sentence: Las pruebas fósiles muestran que una herida de mordida en un cráneo de Velociraptor no cicatrizó, lo que sugiere que la lesión probablemente causó la muerte del animal.
findings.problem: Refers to 'a bite wound on a Velociraptor skull' as if it were a new specimen, when it is the same 1995 skull from the previous sentence.
findings.correct: The bone around these wounds shows no sign of healing, so the injury probably killed the animal.

findings.en_sentence: Velociraptor was first described in 1924 and was initially classified in the family Megalosauridae.
findings.es_sentence: Velociraptor fue descrito por primera vez en 1924 e inicialmente se clasificó en la familia Megalosauridae.
findings.problem: Repeats the 1924 description given in the previous sentence.
findings.correct: At the time it was placed in the family Megalosauridae, like most carnivorous dinosaurs.

findings.es_sentence: La presencia de plumas en Velociraptor sugiere que los maniraptoranos más grandes y no voladores no perdieron las plumas de forma secundaria debido a su tamaño.
findings.problem: 'maniraptoranos' is a calque of English 'maniraptorans'; the Spanish term is 'maniraptores' (or 'manirraptores').
findings.correct: los maniraptores más grandes y no voladores

findings.es_sentence: Las plumas de Velociraptor pudieron haberse utilizado para exhibición, para cuidar de los nidos o para ayudar a subir por pendientes.
findings.problem: 'cuidar de los nidos' does not render brooding (covering the nest while incubating).
findings.correct: para exhibición, para cubrir los nidos durante la incubación o para ayudar a correr cuesta arriba

findings.es_sentence: Velociraptor era de sangre caliente en algún grado debido a los altos requerimientos energéticos de la caza.
findings.problem: 'en algún grado' is a calque of 'to some degree'.

findings.es_sentence: Aunque una vez se creía que la cola de Velociraptor era rígida y en forma de varilla, las pruebas fósiles de una cola en forma de S sugieren que tenía una flexibilidad horizontal significativa.
findings.problem: 'una vez se creía' is a calque of 'it was once believed'.

findings.es_sentence: Velociraptor osmolskae vivió junto a diversas especies incluyendo Pinacosaurus, Linhenykus, Linheraptor, Machairasaurus, Bagaceratops y otros en la Formación Bayan Mandahu.
findings.problem: 'diversas especies … y otros' should agree in gender ('otras'); 'incluyendo' is an anglicised gerund.
findings.correct: junto a diversas especies, entre ellas Pinacosaurus, Linhenykus, Linheraptor, Machairasaurus, Bagaceratops y otras
